scenes.label: Forest, midday
scenes.description: Soft canopy wind, scattered birds at distance, a slow creek behind it all.

scenes.label: Forest, night
scenes.description: Wind through dark canopy, night insects far off, a slow creek behind it. No birds.

scenes.label: Forest, evening rain
scenes.description: Light rain dripping through a cloud forest at dusk, wind in the tree tops, a slow creek, quiet birds settling.

scenes.label: Waterfall valley
scenes.description: A mossy cascade close by, a steadier fall down the valley, a small creek over rocks below. Continuous water, no weather.

scenes.label: Rain on the window
scenes.description: Steady rain against glass, distant rain on pavement, a bass rumble miles off.

scenes.label: Monsoon
scenes.description: Steady rain deep in the rainforest, softer rain farther off, muffled thunder behind it all.

scenes.label: Ocean, at night
scenes.description: Surf rolling against a sand beach, crashing waves further out, the occasional distant shipyard across the bay.

scenes.label: Fireplace
scenes.description: Slow wood fire close at hand, a distant room-mic crackle behind it.

scenes.label: Singing bowls
scenes.description: Deep bronze bowl drone with a slow shimmer of higher bowls overhead. Designed as a sound-bath bed under meditations.
